deployments_detail.use: RPA + AI + chatbots to transform claims processing

Generali Global Corporate & Commercial (GC&C) launched GlobalTracer, a proprietary generative-AI solution that verifies local policy terms, identifies coverage gaps and analyzes large documentation volumes to improve accuracy and alignment across multinational insurance programs in 180+ countries. [Generali proprietary (Generative AI; vendor not disclosed)]

Generali GC&C deployed AGORA, a Gen AI-powered SaaS underwriting platform (Capgemini implementation on Microsoft Dynamics 365 / Power Platform) automating pre-bind underwriting, document management, and data extraction/enrichment across 25 countries, replacing legacy systems. [Capgemini + Microsoft (Dynamics 365, Power Platform, SharePoint) with Gen AI assistant]
deployments_detail.value: 80% faster pre-bind underwriting; 60% lower licensing cost; 75% lower support/maintenance staffing; 75% fewer service desk tickets

deployments_detail.use: Generali Italia used Google Cloud AutoML/AutoML Vision and Cloud TPU to build automated claims processing for simple auto accident claims (customers upload photos/info, AI estimates claim value and delivers fast cash settlement); 80+ predictive models in production. Also uses AI for IFRS 17 simulations and customer knowledge-base virtual assistants. [Google Cloud (AutoML, AutoML Vision, Cloud TPU)]
deployments_detail.value: 80+ predictive models in production; projects delivered in weeks/months instead of years

deployments_detail.use: Generali expanded deployment of Intermap's Aquarius Risk Management & Analytics (RMA), an AI-enabled risk platform using high-resolution 3D terrain and peril analytics, for underwriting, accumulation management, reinsurance and portfolio modeling across Central & Eastern Europe (Czech Republic, then Poland, Hungary, Slovenia). [Intermap (Aquarius RMA)]

Generali Hong Kong deployed CoverGo's Intelligent Document Processing (IDP) AI agent to automate health insurance claims, extracting data from unstructured documents (claim forms, medical reports, invoices), mapping ICD/benefit codes and producing structured decision-ready data in real time. [CoverGo (IDP AI agent)]
MIT collaboration (3 research teams): risk modeling, claims assessment, smart underwriting

Generali France deployed Shift Technology's AI-native fraud detection (Force) for property & casualty claims (multi-risk home and business), cross-referencing internal and third-party data to generate suspicion scores and fraud alerts for adjusters; expanded from an auto-insurance partnership begun in 2016. [Shift Technology (Force)]
deployments_detail.value: ~3,000 claims analyzed daily; target 2% fraud detection rate on 107,000 P&C claims

deployments_detail.use: Generali France equipped 3,700 employees with Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio and Azure OpenAI, with ~50 specialized agents and 17 live business use cases; 100% of staff have Copilot Chat access. AI resolves 1.3M calls (30% of requests) without human intervention. [Microsoft (M365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Azure OpenAI)]
deployments_detail.value: 3,700 employees on Copilot; 1.3M calls (30%) resolved by AI without human intervention; 70% adoption

deployments_detail.use: Generali Switzerland launched 'Chatty', a generative-AI customer-service chatbot (built on DocBrain and ChatGPT with Enterprise Bot / HITS) that helps customers select policies, answers coverage questions and assists with claims in four languages (German, French, Italian, English). [Enterprise Bot / HITS (DocBrain + OpenAI ChatGPT)]

Generali Italia used Google Cloud Vertex AI to build a model evaluation pipeline that helps ML teams quickly evaluate model performance and deploy models (MLOps tooling for the data science organization). [Google Cloud (Vertex AI)]
